fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-02-04, Nithya Rani, aged 41, could not be traced after leaving home for a visit to relatives; the last sighting was near Nallur Garden Residential Colony. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-02-04 at about 16:45. The complaint was lodged by Arun Prakash (9000000194), a family member of Nithya Rani. The family mentioned that Vignesh Natarajan (9000000177) was last known to be in contact with the missing person. A further person, Mathan Chandran, a business acquaintance, using the number 9000000343, is stated to be associated with the incident. Ezhilan Sundaram was mentioned as a person who was present nearby, but no contact number was available. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a witness statement, photographs and mobile phone records.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Witness statement; Photograph; Mobile phone record
fields.Modus_Operandi: Last known location noted near a public transport point.
